prompt:
PATCH V4 — add safe historical/backdate accounting input to the existing Papa Sauce Lab app WITHOUT removing working v3 features. The user already has around 10 days of past accounting data that must be entered oldest-to-newest while preserving the hard-lock rollover rule.

MANDATORY BACKDATE WORKFLOW:
1) Add a clearly visible global 'Tanggal Operasional' selector on Dashboard, default today, allowing past dates. When a past date is selected show a clear BACKDATE / TANGGAL LAMA indicator.
2) Input Sales, Pengeluaran, Restock, and Stock Keluar must all include a Tanggal field prefilled from Tanggal Operasional, editable before save. Saving must use that chosen business date, not always today's device date. Keep createdAt/audit timestamp as the real current timestamp so audit history shows when data was actually entered.
3) Dashboard totals must calculate for the selected Tanggal Operasional, not always today.
4) 'Tutup Hari' must close the selected operational date, create an immutable daily snapshot for that date, and set that day's Total Register as the House Bank/opening balance for the NEXT date. Preserve hard lock: Total Sales = Cash + QRIS + Gojek + Grab; Total Register = House Bank + Total Sales - Total Out; close date D => Register(D) becomes HB(D+1).
5) For backfilling, support the exact sequence: choose oldest date → enter all sales/expenses/stock → Tutup Hari → move to next date → next date automatically uses prior day's Register as HB → repeat until today.
6) Prevent accidental duplicate close for a date already closed; show snapshot/detail instead unless OWNER explicitly uses a clearly labelled correction/reopen workflow. Do not silently overwrite closed snapshots.
7) Historical reports must show the correct date-specific opening HB, channel sales, total out, register, stock movement, closing stock, expected/actual/variance.
8) History/search must retain both business date and real audit timestamp.
9) Existing IndexedDB data must remain readable after update; do not reset or delete v3 local data. Migrate safely if schema changes are needed.
10) Do NOT require changing Android phone date/time.

LOGO FIX IN SAME PATCH:
- The current in-app header image sometimes appears as a broken image placeholder even though icon.svg exists. Replace the header image dependency with an INLINE self-contained PSL logo (red/white/cream, text PSL / Papa Sauce Lab or clean vector mark) so it can never show a broken-image icon. Keep the corrected Android launcher icon from v3; do not revert it.

DO NOT REGRESS:
- Keep all current working screens/actions: Dashboard, Transaksi, Stock, Laporan, Riwayat, Settings, correction/audit, Owner/Staff, Periode Baru, export CSV/PDF/WhatsApp/backup if present.
- Preserve products and expense categories already defined.
- No markdown fences or stray text. Return complete valid HTML only.
- Every visible button must work.

UX goal: user should be able to reconstruct 10 missed days confidently by selecting a date once, entering that day's transactions, closing it, then proceeding to the next day.
